releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What changed

- Add multiple independent task-registry profiles inside one Obsidian vault.
- Each profile has its own folders, Singularity workflow mapping, external-link fields, waiting tags, old-item threshold, and AI-readable snapshot path.
- Add a profile switcher to the registry view.
- Migrate existing 1.2.x single-registry settings into one profile without changing its folder scope or snapshot path.
- Keep the registry disabled by default for new vaults.
- Reject duplicate snapshot paths so one profile cannot overwrite another profile's AI index.
- Extend automatic document-type inference to common English and Russian filenames.

Vault paths, project names, task IDs, and API credentials remain in local plugin settings and are not bundled in the release.

## Verification

- 13 unit tests passed.
- Production build passed.
- Release asset digests match the locally installed build.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What changed

- Old unlinked notes move to a dedicated **Triage old** stage after a configurable age threshold (90 days by default).
- Triage and Archive stay out of the default Active view.
- Summary labels wrap correctly in narrower Obsidian windows.
- The task registry is opt-in for new vaults.
- The persistent snapshot records the configured triage threshold.

## Verification

- 10 unit tests passed.
- Production build passed.
- Live RTL validation: 109 grouped entities, 83/83 linked tasks resolved, 23 old notes in Triage old, 0 false attention/conflicts.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
## What's new

- Adds a configurable **Task Registry** view for Obsidian document workflows.
- Combines notes, Singularity projects/statuses/tags/deadlines, and external issue links.
- Groups related specifications, questions, and implementation checks into one entity.
- Detects workflow inconsistencies and provides search, stage filters, and direct links.
- Stores a sanitized AI-readable snapshot with offline fallback and stale-data indicators.
- Recovers only referenced historical tasks omitted by Singularity's list endpoint.

## RTL validation

- 128 Markdown files grouped into 109 workflow entities.
- All 83 linked Singularity task IDs resolved.
- No false task/link conflicts after the live refresh.

## Verification

- 8 automated tests passed.
- TypeScript and production build passed.
- Release assets match the build visually checked in the working Obsidian vault.

See [PR #1](https://github.com/SVS696/obsidian-singularity/pull/1) for implementation details.

releases.author: SVS696
releases.description:
## What's New

### Language Setting
- Added language setting (English / Русский) in plugin settings
- Localized status labels: Done/Готово, Cancelled/Отменена  
- Localized tooltips and loading states

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed inline URL processing in Reading View
- Fixed Source mode showing widgets (now shows raw text)
- Fixed "Done" status color

## Installation
1. Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`
2. Place them in `.obsidian/plugins/singularity-app/`
3. Enable the plugin in Settings
